$comment: The drives from the cabin (GAME_DESIGN 2.2, 3.2, 3.3; BUILD_PLAN 2.6). Places by id (each a place in the gazetteer, content/text/names/), roads by id (roads, which the dated conditions name: content/park/conditions/2026.json applies them by date); the scenes and their words are S15a's. minutes are whole minutes of driving, each leg an estimate with its evidence. trip_time: whether the drive costs the trip's clock (the departure-morning drive sets Day 1's start, 3.3; the town run costs no trip time, 2.2, so its minutes only pace its scenes).
